question: By defeating which country, did china win the 2019 Sudirman Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• China defeated **Japan** to win the 2019 Sudirman Cup.
 
• The final match was held on **26th May 2019**.
 
• China won the Sudirman Cup by a score of **3-0** in the final.
 
• This victory marked China's **11th Sudirman Cup title**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sudirman Cup**

 
 
• The Sudirman Cup is a mixed team badminton championship which takes place every two years.
 
• The tournament was first held in **1989** in Jakarta, Indonesia.
 
• It is named after **Dick Sudirman**, a former Indonesian badminton player and the founder of the Badminton Association of Indonesia (PBSI).
 
• Teams from all over the world participate, competing in five categories: men's singles, women's singles, men's doubles, women's doubles, and mixed doubles.
 
 
 
• **China's Dominance**
 
 
• China is the most successful team in the history of the Sudirman Cup, having won it **11 times**.
 
• Their dominance in badminton is attributed to a strong infrastructure for the sport and a rigorous training program.
 
• China has produced numerous world-class badminton players who have excelled in various international tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Japan's Performance**
 
 
• Japan has been a strong contender in international badminton, and reaching the final in 2019 was a significant achievement.
 
• Japanese players have shown remarkable progress in recent years, winning several titles in both individual and team events.
